Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: Public comment posted by a Google-authenticated reader on an editorial article.

postId.description: Numeric ID of the article post.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the comment author.

authorName.description: Display name of the authenticated Google user.

authorPhotoUrl.description: Optional Google avatar URL of the comment author.

NewsletterSubscription.title: NewsletterSubscription
NewsletterSubscription.description: Private email subscription record for receiving new articles directly by email.

userUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the subscriber.

notifyNewArticles.description: Whether the reader wants to receive every new article by email.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when subscription was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when subscription was last updated.

EditorialArticle.title: EditorialArticle
EditorialArticle.description: Article managed via the Achar Temas editorial CMS.

postId.description: Unique positive numeric ID for the article (>= 1000 for CMS articles).

excerpt.description: Short summary shown in editorial cards.

categoryId.description: Category ID mapped to one of the editorial pillars.

heroImage.description: Hero illustration URL or local asset path.

published.description: Whether the article is publicly visible.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the editorial admin who created the article.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when article was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when article was last updated.

ContactMessage.title: ContactMessage
ContactMessage.description: Reader contact message submitted through the Contato page (admin-only read).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was submitted.

GameScore.title: GameScore
GameScore.description: Verified player personal best score per authored mini-game for the portal leaderboard.

userUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

bestScore.description: Best numeric score achieved by the player in this game.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of first recorded score.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest high score.

/comments/{commentId}.description: Publicly readable reader comments on blog posts; verified Google users can create or delete their own comments, and the editorial admin can moderate.

/newsletter_subscriptions/{userId}.description: Isolated PII collection storing reader email subscriptions keyed by auth UID; readable and writable by the owner, and listable by verified editorial admin.

/articles/{articleId}.description: CMS articles managed by the verified editorial admin; published articles are publicly readable.

/contact_messages/{messageId}.description: Reader contact submissions (write-only for visitors with strict schema validation; readable and updatable only by verified editorial admin).

/game_scores/{scoreId}.description: Publicly readable leaderboard scores per game; verified Google users can record and improve their own score document.
